_kommentar: Action item-banken för strategrapporten till Bruce (creative strategist, Matstrumpor). Byggd 2026-10-03 ur hans SOP (matstrumpor/sop/BRUCE-WEEKLY-SELF-REVIEW.md), Evolves iterationsplaybook (docs/os/evolve/ITERATIONS-PLAYBOOK.md), matstrumpor/lardom.mjs PLAYBOOK_PER_UTFALL och CS-KLART.md. Nyckeln väljs av läget (matt.mjs actionNyckel): kön med bedömbara rader först, sedan saknad ny rad, sedan vinnare utan tre iterationer, sedan Done utan lärdom, sedan bästa egna utfallet, sist allmänt. ETT item per vecka, aldrig samma två gånger förrän listan är slut (minnet i data/historik.jsonl). Engelska utan tankstreck, inga butiksnamn, inga kronor.

ko_bedombar_kvar.text_en: Close the rows with enough data first. Open each one, write what differed from the brief, hook or hold against the best batch, and one line that starts with Guess. Then STATUS = Done.
ko_bedombar_kvar.kalla: SOP steg 1 till 4; CS-KLART punkt 1 och 5

ko_bedombar_kvar.text_en: End every LEARNINGS you write with the next ad you would make from it, one line. A learning without a next test is a diary entry, not a system.
Before you judge an idea, check the cut against the brief. If the video differs from what the brief asked for, the loss is the execution, and you write which part differed.

ingen_ny_rad.text_en: Add next week's concept as ONE row in Ad Roadmap before you brief it: WHY, WHAT and HOW in BREAKTHROUGH MEMO, plus desire, sub avatar, angle, awareness level and ad type.
ingen_ny_rad.kalla: SOP 'Then add ONE row'; Evolve Growth Guide 3.0 Ad Roadmap

ingen_ny_rad.text_en: Take the new row from the planning tabs: one desire, one sub avatar, one angle. Write in the memo which row in each tab it comes from, so the next person can follow the thread.
ingen_ny_rad.kalla: Evolve Growth Guide 3.0: Desires, Sub Avatars, Awareness

ingen_ny_rad.text_en: Write the new row's hook line first, then the memo. If the first frame cannot show what the line talks about, change the line before you brief it.

vinnare_utan_iteration.text_en: Build on the winner before anything new: the same hook and the same creator, with a longer problem section before the reveal.
Take the winner one awareness level up or down: the same promise told to someone who does not know the problem yet, or to someone already comparing options.
Start the winner in the middle of the action: cut the setup and open on the moment the gift is unwrapped. Same body after that.

done_utan_lardom.text_en: A row is Done only when LEARNINGS holds a line. Open the rows you set to Done without one and write either Too little data or the three lines from the SOP.

BREAKTHROUGH.text_en: Write the component map for the winner: which seconds are the hook, the bridge, the hold and the call to action. The next three iterations are built on that map.
Plan three iterations on the winner inside 14 days and put each one in Ad Roadmap as its own row with Iteration as ad type.

SPEND_WINNER.text_en: People stopped and stayed but did not buy enough. In the next brief for this concept, add belief or urgency in the bridge. Keep the hook.
Read the comments on the spend winner and write the objection that comes up most. Answer it in the next version of this concept.

KPI_WINNER.text_en: It converts when shown, but Meta shows it little. Next version: the next unused hook line from the brief on the same body, nothing else changed.

LOSER.text_en: Write one new hook line for the loser where the first frame shows the object the line talks about. One line, not a rewrite of the concept.
Decide in LEARNINGS whether the loser gets one more try or is dropped. An idea from research gets two or three tries with a new reason each time; a lost imitation gets none.

INGEN_LEVERANS.text_en: Meta never showed these. Look only at the first frame and the first line of each, then write one decision per row in LEARNINGS: new first frame, or drop.

allmant.text_en: Pick one Done row and rewrite its LEARNINGS so that a new editor would know exactly what to cut next. That is the standard for every row from now on.
Read the three breakthrough memos you are proudest of and check each has WHY, WHAT and HOW. Fill in the part that is missing.
